summary: Mask tool family - split Points / Detect / Shapes / Text into real sibling tools and extract the shared brush/eraser/invert/clear/opacity strip into ONE component. Two open questions for the user before implementation.

User answered all three open questions: one rail icon per tool inside the existing MASK group (no switcher), settings persist, and the shared strip must make the brush + eraser pair optional because the Points tool has no use for them. Design check recorded - Add bakes into manualCanvas and the brush is how that is cleaned up, so with no brush on Points cleanup means switching tools.

Implementation started. User confirmed: NO separate Paint tool - the brush/eraser/invert/clear/opacity strip is ONE component present at the bottom of EVERY mask tool, with the brush + eraser pair gated off where it makes no sense (Points, probably Shapes). Second shared compound approved for the thumbs / Detect / Add / Subtract / queue-gate row.

Compact checklist derived: MpiMaskStrip + MpiMaskDetectRow compounds, MpiToolOptionsMaskDetect + MpiToolOptionsMaskPoints organisms, delete MpiToolOptionsMask, rail split, block sweep, preloadStyles + types registration, then app verification.

Implementation complete. MpiMaskStrip + MpiMaskDetectRow compounds and MpiToolOptionsMaskDetect + MpiToolOptionsMaskPoints organisms shipped; MpiToolOptionsMask deleted. Rail modes maskDetect / maskPoints bridged to the viewer mask mode by _viewerModeFor(). Settings stay on the single mask tool key so they persist across a tool swap.

Automated checks PASS - eslint clean, all four new modules and css load in the live app, and 14/14 stub-viewer contract checks pass including both traps: Points destroy() calls setMaskPointsMode(false), and neither destroy() calls clearMask(). Awaiting user verification of the rail, persistence across restart and the two detect paths.

Docs + rules synced on the user's explicit permission (CLAUDE.md rule 5). Updated component-mounts.md, component-events-organisms.md, component-events-blocks.md and component-state.md to the tool family + the two shared compounds, and added the missing Masking row to the CLAUDE.md Context Router pointing at docs/masking.md. component-state.md now records that toolSettings.mask source is a DEAD key - the branch is chosen by which tool is mounted.

User exercised both tools in the app - rail, Detect, Points, Scope, Add, Subtract, the shared strip and the brush gating all behave. Verdict: everything working nicely apart from one defect, which turned out to be an MPI-361 Phase A layer-ORDER bug (green preview skipped a previously-subtracted region) and is logged and fixed on that card. Maturity -> validating pending the user re-checking that one case.

USER-VERIFIED LIVE. Mask tool family shipped: MpiToolOptionsMaskDetect + MpiToolOptionsMaskPoints over the shared MpiMaskDetectRow + MpiMaskStrip (brush pair optional, hidden on Points); MpiToolOptionsMask deleted; one mask toolKey keeps settings across swaps. Both traps proven headlessly. The defect the user found during verification was an MPI-361 layer-ORDER bug, fixed on that card and also user-verified.
